mathematical_definition: velocity_t / c_t, where velocity is the latent trend-slope state of the same local-level Kalman filter (features.kalman.kalman_local_level, q=1e-5, r=1.0) -- normalized trend slope
numerical_stability_notes: velocity[0]=0 by construction (filter seeded with zero initial slope)
missing_value_policy: Defined from the first bar (velocity[0]=0 by construction); never NaN unless the input close itself is NaN
